content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Port Management Board Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Port Management Board Inland Vessel Surveyor Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Inland Vessel Surveyor: Marine or Mechanical or Electrical Engineer or Naval Architect in possession of minimum First or Second class Motor/Steam Ministry of Transport (MOT) Certificate issued by Directorate General of Shipping, Government of India or equivalent certificate recognized by the Government of India Master Mariner(Foreign Going) Marine Engineer Operator Class III (Near Coastal Voyage Vessel (NCV)-Chief Engineer Officer) Certificate or Master (NCV) Certificate Inland Vessel Master Class I or Inland Engineer Certificate Basic degree in Naval Architecture Diploma in ship building Experience: 5 to 15 years of experience based on qualification

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Inland Vessel Surveyor: Rs. 90,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Personal talk, professional knowledge and experience assessment

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Port Management Board Inland Vessel Surveyor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the Inland Vessel Surveyor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the position of Inland Vessel Surveyor under the Port Management Board, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates must attend the interview at the specified venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Inland Vessel Surveyor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Inland Vessel Surveyor post is 55 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary for the Inland Vessel Surveyor?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the post of Inland Vessel Surveyor will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 90,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What are the dates for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Inland Vessel Surveyor post is scheduled to be held from 05 October 2026 to 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Conference Hall, Port Management Board, Andaman and Nicobar Administration, Port Blair.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Inland Vessel Surveyor recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree or diploma in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Naval Architecture, or relevant certificates like Master Mariner or Inland Vessel Master/Engineer with 5 to 15 years of experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Inland Vessel Surveyor position is offered on a contract basis under the Port Management Board, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original educational certificates, experience certificates, proof of identity, self-attested photocopies of all documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.
